notes.title: Eggplant is Officially Released!
notes.content:
Good day, everyone!

Eggplant is now out!🍆🍆🍆

This is my first time creating and releasing a game, so there are many aspects to improve. With your help and feedback, I'll do my best to make it better.

Currently there are 3 active drop pools:
[list]
[b][*]Daily - Granted daily (every 24 hours)
[*]Granted every 2 hours
[*]Granted every 10 hours (higher chances of rare drops)[/b]
[/list]

Let's go!🍆🍆🍆
